instruction: I need GIMP to run in full-screen mode by default. Can you configure that setting?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not have a preference setting to launch in full-screen mode by default. While users can manually enter full-screen mode using F11, there is no configuration option to make full-screen the default startup mode.
